description_en: Retrieve slow query statistics for a time range
description_zh: 获取指定时间段内慢查询统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb describe-slow-query-stats --db-instance-id selectdb-cn-7213cjv0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2026-04-07_16:00:00 --end-time 2026-04-08_16:00:00 --threshold-ms 5000 --topn 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSlowQueryStats

parameters.description_en: The start time. Defaults to 24 hours before the current time.
parameters.help_en: The start time. Defaults to 24 hours before the current time
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end time. Must be later than the start time. Defaults to the current time.
parameters.description_zh: 结束时间，需大于起始时间，默认为现在时间。
parameters.help_en: The end time. Must be later than the start time. Defaults to the current time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，需大于起始时间，默认为现在时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en: The slow query threshold, in milliseconds. The default value is 5000.
parameters.description_zh: 慢查询阈值，单位毫秒，默认值5000。
parameters.help_en: The slow query threshold, in milliseconds. The default value is 5000
parameters.help_zh: 慢查询阈值，单位毫秒，默认值5000
parameters.name: threshold_ms

parameters.description_en: The number of top slow queries to return. The default value is 10.
parameters.help_en: The number of top slow queries to return. The default value is 10
parameters.name: topn
